datasheet_identity.title: 1SMA5913A THRU 1SMA5945A SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES (SMA Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes)

extraction_notes: The 1SMA5929A row gives VZ min/nom/max = 14.25/15.0/15.75 V at IZT = 25 mA; ZZT maximum 9 ohm at IZT; ZZK maximum 600 ohm at IZK = 1.0 mA; IR maximum 5 microA at VR = 11.4 V (p. 2).
The p. 3 zener-characteristic plots are family-level traces without per-part labels, so no 1SMA5929A-specific electrical curve was assigned.
The p. 3 capacitance and impedance plots are family-level and no per-part capacitance is tabulated. No reverse-recovery time is published.
omission_reason: No usable 1SMA5929A-specific electrical curve is published: the p. 3 zener plots are unlabeled family traces, so a trace cannot be assigned to the 15 V part without inventing evidence.

breakdown_voltage.conditions: IZT = 0.025 A, Ta = 25 degC; nominal VZ
